# Catalog

# The single source of truth for protocol coverage. Grammar, one item per
# line: `- NN. slug — description · genre`. Items 1-22 are proven by the
# gem's own suite (spec/wire/acceptance_spec.rb, same numbering); items 23+
# are lived by the example — genre «scene» on a page, «spec» as a property
# spec — and every one is pinned by a `# catalog: NN-slug` marker in the
# example suite. The two-way lock is script/catalog_check.rb; the readable
# table is generated by it (--table) and never written by hand.

# Gem suite

- 1. concurrency — exactly one of N threads wins, one log row · suite
- 2. bypass-policy — direct refuses over event guards, bypass is legal · suite
- 3. guard-matrix — edge and event guards coexist on one edge · suite
- 4. loops — a from == to loop writes a log row · suite
- 5. initial-state — birth is not a transition, the log stays silent · suite
- 6. in-state-equivalent — in_state? is a plain column read · suite
- 7. compilation-catches — all five compilation errors · suite
- 8. re-entrancy — NestedTransitionError inside the start..CAS window · suite
- 9. chains — chained transitions, the ceiling of 16, the printed chain · suite
- 10. savepoint-transactions — savepoint rollback isolation · suite
- 11. cas-side-effects — CAS with touch and changed_at · suite
- 12. fk-cascade — FK on_delete cascade removes the log · suite
- 13. generated-check — the CHECK constraint of a generated table · suite
- 14. introspection-surface — can_fire?, available_events · suite
- 15. available-transitions — to/via descriptors with direct · suite
- 16. transitioned-to — strictly log-based · suite
- 17. scopes-flag — scopes behind the flag, name conflicts caught · suite
- 18. programmer-errors — Dirty/Unsaved/Nested/ChainDepth never swallowed · suite
- 19. metadata-contract — round-trip normalization, deep freeze · suite
- 20. sti — base_class everywhere, descendants in scopes · suite
- 21. multi-database-boundary — ConnectionMismatch across connections · suite
- 22. transactional-invariant-telemetry — after_commit semantics and events · suite
